fableReview.reviewBasis: Full read of both affected final stories (en-a1-day-owl, en-a2-low-tide) against the ten exact changes. Owl count is now coherent: p1 artBrief (five alert owls plus Pip at the end) matches hotspot 'Six owls sit on a long branch' in text/meaning/notes (en+de); p6 artBrief (six on the branch, five in a line turned towards Pip the sixth) matches hotspot 'Five owls sit in a line and listen' and the de meaning; narrator line 'The owls sit in a row' remains neutral; p3/p4/p5 'the other owls' references unaffected. Binoculars continuity: p1 Eli holds them, p3 Eli looks through them, p5 they rest on the wall between Eli and Mara; p6 bench scene does not reference them. No new inconsistencies introduced; German meanings and notes in changed fields are accurate. Both prior LOW observations are resolved.
limitations: No tools: final sourceHashes echoed from the prompt, not recomputed.
Only the two affected stories were re-read; the other 14 stories (including all Spanish) are accepted as unchanged on the parent's assertion and the identical spanish.json hash.
Editor-model check of English/German text; no native-human review or originality certification is claimed.

findings.problem: Page 1 art brief reads as five alert owls plus Pip at the end of the branch (six on the branch), and page 6 explicitly shows six owls in a row. Hotspot text 'Five owls sit on a long branch.' undercounts if Pip is included; ambiguous rather than wrong.
findings.exactFix: Either change the text/meaning to 'Six owls sit on a long branch.' / 'Sechs Eulen sitzen auf einem langen Ast.' or edit the artBrief to 'Four owls sit alert ... At the end of the branch, Pip' so five is exact.

findings.problem: Pages 1 and 3 give Eli the binoculars (hotspot 'Eli looks through heavy binoculars'); page 5 art has Mara wearing binoculars around her neck with no handover. Minor art continuity drift, defensible as a shared pair.
findings.exactFix: Change 'Mara leans beside Eli with binoculars around her neck, pointing at the empty water.' to 'Mara leans beside Eli, pointing at the empty water; Eli's binoculars rest on the wall between them.'

scopeLimitations: No tools: hashes echoed from the prompt, not recomputed.

Parent arbitration items confirmed as resolved in text: es-a2 ascensor p4 shows ground-floor coffee with Tomás beside the closed faulty lift; es-b2 grullas p5-p6 has Serena and Tula departing together, and the p6 water-gleam hotspot carries no ice advice. Not reverted.
Target-language text, meanings and notes checked by an editor model; no native-human certification or originality certification is claimed.

Shared first names across unrelated stories (Marta, Tomás in two Spanish episodes; Tom, Dev, Priya across English episodes) noted but not flagged: each episode is self-contained and no requirement for cross-episode uniqueness was given.

Irregular-participle and gender notes (impreso, roto, el agua/el ala, azul, grande, cada, hacia/hacía) checked for accuracy and found correct; no further factual claims in the texts exceed the fiction notes.
